entities.summary: Tuula Teeri is a Finnish molecular geneticist and the President of the Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences (IVA). She has previously been a Vice President at the Royal Institute of Technology (KTH) in Stockholm and President of Aalto University from April 1, 2009 to 2017. Professor Teeri started as the President of IVA on November 1, 2017
